lines.text: So, Son, where do you see yourself in the next three to five years?

lines.speaker: Son (Candidate)
lines.text: I set a target to grow from developer to technical lead within five years.

lines.speaker: Mai (Interviewer)
lines.text: That's a clear goal. Do you have a realistic timeline for each step?

lines.speaker: Son (Candidate)
lines.text: Yes, I plan to master system design in year two, then move into mentoring.

lines.speaker: Mai (Interviewer)
lines.text: Do you have a personal growth plan to support that?

lines.speaker: Son (Candidate)
lines.text: I do. I'm taking an architecture course and reading about leadership every month.

lines.speaker: Mai (Interviewer)
lines.text: Good. How do you make sure your goals align with company goals?

lines.speaker: Son (Candidate)
lines.text: I always check in with my manager to make sure my plan fits the roadmap.

lines.speaker: Mai (Interviewer)
lines.text: How do you measure your progress along the way?

lines.speaker: Son (Candidate)
lines.text: I review it every quarter and adjust the plan if something changes.

lines.speaker: Mai (Interviewer)
lines.text: Do you envision your future role as purely technical, or also managing people?

lines.speaker: Son (Candidate)
lines.text: Both, actually. Leading a big migration is a stretch goal, and I like to chart my own path.
